title: Upgrade Baileys to v7.0.0-rc14 in whatsapp-bridge
description: Baileys 6.7.22 (Nov 2025) es incompatible con el protocolo actual de WhatsApp: socket connected pero ghost session (init queries timeout 408, envios responden success pero no entregan, no recibe mensajes entrantes). Upgrade a 7.0.0-rc14 que incluye fix de ghost sessions y LID/PN mappings.

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX complexity. Complexity drivers: category requires council. Required agents (8): architect, backend, frontend, qa, release, infrastructure_bootstrap, infrastructure_guardian, memory_engineer.
